articles.summary: Stryker has signed a definitive agreement to acquire ZuriMED, developer of the FiberLocker System, a commercialized technology that provides a novel approach for rotator cuff augmentation designed for increased biomechanical strength.
articles.title: Stryker signs definitive agreement to acquire ZuriMED to enhance its shoulder offering

articles.summary: Stryker Chair and CEO Kevin Lobo and President and COO Spencer Stiles recently sat down with Bloomberg’s Matt Henriksson to discuss how our culture and disciplined approach to M&A fuels our market-leading growth.
articles.title: Listen to Stryker’s Kevin Lobo and Spencer Stiles on Bloomberg Intelligence Vanguards of Healthcare podcast
